lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap chhod sevaa karee pir sachaRaa milai sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: Renouncing ego, I serve them; thus I meet my True Husband Lord, with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਏ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir sachaa milai aae saach kamaae saach sabad dhan raatee ||
lines.translation: The True Husband Lord comes to meet the soul-bride who practices Truth, and is imbued with the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਾਂਡ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kade na raa(n)d sadaa sohaagan a(n)tar sahaj samaadhee ||
lines.translation: She shall never become a widow; she shall always be a happy bride. Deep within herself, she dwells in the celestial bliss of Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir rahiaa bharapoore vekh hadoore ra(n)g maane sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: Her Husband Lord is fully pervading everywhere; beholding Him ever-present, she enjoys His Love, with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jinee aapanaa ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin poochhau sa(n)taa jaae ||3||
lines.translation: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa bhee milah je satigur laagah saache paae ||
lines.translation: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sadaa daiaal hai avagun sabad jalaae ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is forever merciful; through the Word of His Shabad, demerits are burnt away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਏ ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: augun sabad jalaae doojaa bhaau gavaae sache hee sach raatee ||
lines.translation: Burning away her demerits through the Shabad, the soul-bride eradicates her love of duality, and remains absorbed in the True, True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad sadaa sukh paaiaa haumai gaee bharaatee ||
lines.translation: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt are dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir niramaail sadaa sukhadaataa naanak sabad milaae ||
lines.translation: The Immaculate Husband Lord is forever the Giver of peace; O Nanak, through the Word of His Shabad, He is met.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: pirahu vichhu(n)neeaa bhee milah je satigur laagah saache paae ||4||1||
lines.translation: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: suniahu ka(n)t maheleeho pir sevihu sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: avaganava(n)tee pir na jaanaee muthee rovai ka(n)t visaar ||
lines.translation: The worthless bride does not know her Husband Lord - she is deluded; forgetting her Husband Lord, she weeps and wails.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਸੰਮਾਲਿ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovai ka(n)t sa(n)maal sadaa gun saar naa pir marai na jaae ||
lines.translation: She weeps, thinking of her Husband Lord, and she cherishes His virtues; her Husband Lord does not die, and does not leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jaataa sabad pachhaataa saachai prem samaae ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, she knows the Lord; through the Word of His Shabad, He is realized; through True Love, she merges with Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin apanaa pir nahee jaataa karam bidhaataa kooR muthee kooRiaare ||
lines.translation: She who does not know her Husband Lord, the Architect of karma, is deluded by falsehood - she herself is false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: suniahu ka(n)t maheleeho pir sevihu sabad veechaare ||1||
lines.translation: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag aap upaaion aavan jaan sa(n)saaraa ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu khuaaian mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaaraa ||
lines.translation: The love of Maya has ruined the world; people die, to be re-born, over and over again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ਵਧਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਮੂਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mar ja(n)mai vaaro vaaraa vadhahi bikaaraa giaan vihoonee moothee ||
lines.translation: People die to be re-born, over and over again, while their sins increase; without spiritual wisdom, they are deluded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ਰੋਵੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai pir na paaio janam gavaaio rovai avaguniaaree jhoothee ||
lines.translation: Without the Word of the Shabad, the Husband Lord is not found; the worthless, false bride wastes her life away, weeping and wailing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੋਈਐ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir jagajeevan kis no roeeai rovai ka(n)t visaare ||
lines.translation: He is my Beloved Husband Lord, the Life of the World - for whom should I weep? They alone weep, who forget their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag aap upaaion aavan jaan sa(n)saare ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: so pir sachaa sad hee saachaa hai naa ohu marai na jaae ||
lines.translation: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਧਨ ਇਆਣੀਆ ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhoolee phirai dhan iaaneeaa ra(n)d baithee doojai bhaae ||
lines.translation: The ignorant soul-bride wanders in delusion; in the love of duality, she sits like a widow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)d baithee doojai bhaae maaiaa mohi dukh paae aav ghatai tan chheejai ||
lines.translation: She sits like a widow, in the love of duality; through emotional attachment to Maya, she suffers in pain. She is growing old, and her body is withering away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਸੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh aaiaa sabh kichh jaasee dukh laagaa bhaai doojai ||
lines.translation: Whatever has come, all that shall pass away; through the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਝੈ ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jamakaal na soojhai maaiaa jag loojhai lab lobh chit laae ||
lines.translation: They do not see the Messenger of Death; they long for Maya, and their consciousness is attached to greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: so pir saachaa sad hee saachaa naa ohu marai na jaae ||3||
lines.translation: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਅੰਧੀ ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik rovahi pirahi vichhu(n)neeaa a(n)dhee naa jaanai pir naale ||
lines.translation: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee saachaa pir milai a(n)tar sadaa samaale ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, they may meet with their True Husband, and cherish Him always deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir a(n)tar samaale sadaa hai naale manamukh jaataa doore ||
lines.translation: She cherishes her Husband deep within herself - He is always with her; the self-willed manmukhs think that He is far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੁਲੈ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਸਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu tan rulai rulaaiaa kaam na aaiaa jin khasam na jaataa hadoore ||
lines.translation: This body rolls in the dust, and is totally useless; it does not realize the Presence of the Lord and Master.
